title: Ext in the second variable is right-derived additive Hom
statement: Let $\mathcal A$ be an abelian category with objects in universe $u$ and morphisms in universe $v$, with injective resolutions and $\operatorname{HasExt}^{v}$. For an object $X$ and $q\in\mathbf N$, the functor $Y\mapsto\operatorname{Ext}^{q}_{\mathcal A}(X,Y)$ valued in abelian groups in universe $v$ is naturally isomorphic to the $q$th right derived functor of $Y\mapsto\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathcal A}(X,Y)$, with the usual additive structures.

source.place: Tag 06XR, lemma-compute-ext (injective-resolution computation); Mathlib InjectiveResolution.extAddEquivCohomologyClass and HomComplex.leftHomologyData

proof.text: Choose the standard injective resolution R of each Y. Mathlib InjectiveResolution.extAddEquivCohomologyClass identifies Ext(X,Y,q) with degree-q cohomology classes of HomComplex(single(X,0),R). HomComplex.leftHomologyData identifies these classes with its homology. Cochain.fromSingleEquiv gives an additive degreewise isomorphism with Hom(X,R), commuting with differentials by Cochain.δ_fromSingleMk. The resolution computation isoRightDerivedObjCochainComplex identifies that homology with derived Hom. Compose these isomorphisms.

For f:Y→Z choose InjectiveResolution.desc f between their standard resolutions. Express a cocycle from single(X,0) by Cocycle.fromSingleMk_surjective. Its Ext image is R.extMk of the corresponding morphism into R.cocomplex; extMk_comp_mk₀ proves compatibility with postcomposition. Build ShortComplex.LeftHomologyMapData with the induced cocycle map and with the conjugate Ext map on cohomology classes; its commπ is the compatibility just proved. The homologyMap_eq formula, naturality of the degreewise from-single isomorphism, and isoRightDerivedObjCochainComplex_inv_naturality prove naturality of the composite component isomorphism. NatIso.ofComponents produces the claimed functor isomorphism.
